title: Plexamp Playback Bitrate Leaderboard
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr/Radarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plexamp:play bitrate_kbps=*
| stats sum(bitrate_kbps) as total_value, avg(bitrate_kbps) as avg_value by playlist_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks playlist values by total and average bitrate across Plexamp playback events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `bitrate_kbps` values for each Plexamp playback event and review total and average bitrate by playlist.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total bitrate.
grandmaExplanation: It honestly which playlist shows the biggest bitrate numbers in your Plexamp playback data.
